name: wrf-python

about.summary: Diagnostic and interpolation routines for WRF-ARW data.
Diagnostic and interpolation routines for WRF-ARW data.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.4.2"

package:
  name: wrf-python
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/NCAR/wrf-python/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 48f360e3319c782e44653bc1e907842724873561c17dbbf1fe56ff625d3dab35

build:
  # windows disabled due to cmake being unable to find a fortran compiler
  number: 2
  skip: win
  script:
    content: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  prefix_detection:
    ignore_binary_files: false

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - cmake
    - if: not win
      then: make
    - if: win
      then: ninja
  host:
    - setuptools
    - pip
    - python
    - python-build
    - numpy
    - scikit-build-core
    # upstream has it as a requirement
    - wrapt
  run:
    - ${{ pin_compatible('numpy') }}
    - netCDF4
    - python
    - setuptools
    - wrapt
    - xarray

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - wrf
      pip_check: false
  - files:
      source:
        - test/ci_tests
    script:
      - cd test/ci_tests && python utests.py

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Diagnostic and interpolation routines for WRF-ARW data.
  homepage: https://github.com/NCAR/wrf-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akrherz
    - erogluorhan
    - kafitzgerald
